title: Sayyid Dynasty
definition: The Sayyid Dynasty (1414–1451 CE) was the fourth dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, established by Khizr Khan following the collapse of the Tughlaq dynasty after Timur's invasion.
importanceInUpsc: Tested for its transitional role between the Tughlaqs and Lodis, the nature of its 'vassal' status to Timurids, and the shrinking territorial extent of the Sultanate.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Sayyid Dynasty.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
